Frequently asked questions

FAQs

Can't find your answer? We reply to every email.

Contact us
Is this a conference?

No. There is no stage and no audience. All three days are workshop-led, with fifteen founders in the room and three advisors working through the businesses in it — including yours.

What do the private hours actually mean?

Every attendee gets scheduled one-to-one time with all three advisors across the weekend — Christian on AI, Marius on ads, James on the business behind both. Sessions are booked in advance so nobody is competing for attention in a corridor. Fifteen seats is what makes that possible.

Where in Paris is it?

We're confirming the venue now. Everyone holding a seat hears first, well ahead of the weekend.

What's included in the ticket?

All three workshop days, your private hours with all three advisors, dinner every evening and the evening programme across the weekend. Flights and accommodation are not included.

Why does the price go up?

The first ten seats are €4,000. Once those are taken the remaining five are €5,000. It is the same room and the same three days either way — the earlier you commit, the less you pay.

Where does AI fit in?

Day One is built around it, led by Christian: where AI genuinely removes cost and time from your business, and where it doesn't. It carries into the ads and branding days too, because that is how it shows up in a real business.

Do I need to attend all three days?

Yes. The weekend is built as one continuous piece of work, ending with a written plan. There is no single-day ticket.

Who should attend?

Established entrepreneurs who already have a business with revenue and want three days of senior attention on it, in a room small enough that everyone gets heard.
